_comment: Cursor → OmniMind. PREFERRED: ~/.cursor/mcp.json (global) or .cursor/mcp.json (project) with mcpServers.omnimind — hosted Streamable HTTP (`url` + `headers`, no `type` key needed) + personal omt_ token from BoardRoom Settings → Connected AI tools. Cursor resolves ${env:NAME} in url and headers, so the ${env:OMNIMIND_TOKEN} form below keeps the token out of the file (export OMNIMIND_TOKEN in your shell). One-click alternative: cursor://anysphere.cursor-deeplink/mcp/install?name=omnimind&config=<base64 of the inner {url, headers} object> (the Settings page renders this link). The URL must not redirect. LEGACY (stdio): mcpServers.omnimind-local runs the server in-process as agent cursor-josh (josh-business, read-only, sourceWeight 0.7) with an omk_ agent key from keygen. Add a .cursor/rules entry 'Start with status_get; log decisions with decision_log' so agent mode honours the freshness contract (docs/runbooks/omnimind-mcp.md §8).
